title: Integrity
definition: Integrity is wholeness of character in which belief, speech, conduct, and private life are brought under the truth of God.
summary: Integrity is wholeness of character in which belief, words, private conduct, and public life agree before God.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is perfectly true and faithful, and He forms His people to walk in sincerity before God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on undivided faithfulness. Integrity means the same Lord rules the hidden and visible parts of life. It rejects double-mindedness, deception, hypocrisy, and selective obedience.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because public ministry or reputation can hide private compromise. Integrity protects witness, relationships, leadership, and conscience. It reminds believers that God sees the whole life, not only the presented life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Bring hidden areas into the light before they harden. Keep promises, tell the truth, and act consistently when no one is watching. Ask trusted believers to help you pursue whole-life faithfulness.
